name: Choose a pack and open a WhatsApp order
description: Verifies a customer can select a pack, change quantity, and start a WhatsApp order with the chosen details.
expected: WhatsApp opens with an order message containing Size XL and quantity 2.

name: Use the mobile WhatsApp ordering flow
description: Verifies the primary ordering controls remain usable on a small viewport.
steps: Open the site on a mobile viewport
expected: The pack selection is usable without horizontal overflow and a WhatsApp order opens for Party Tray.

name: Prevent a quantity below one
description: Verifies the order quantity cannot be reduced below one.
steps: Click the decrease quantity control repeatedly
expected: The quantity remains at 1 and the displayed total does not become negative or zero.

name: Reach contact and location details
description: Verifies customers can find the location, delivery availability, and direct WhatsApp contact.
steps: Review the Amuwo and Lagos delivery details
expected: The page visibly shows WhatsApp 0708 894 6671, Amuwo First Gate, and delivery across Lagos.
